lead_raw_text:
The structure of NaCdAg₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 194), with a unit cell containing eight atoms—Na₂Cd₂Ag₄—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all three elements adopt a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement with eight geometric neighbors per center atom; Ag is surrounded by four Ag, two Cd, and two Na neighbors, while Cd and Na each have eight Ag neighbors, with neighbor distances of 2.88–2.95 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Ag-centered eight-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Cd- and Na-centered polyhedra.
